text: Pick the model: Gemma 4 E2B-it
Get the full BRACOL leaf set
Pick the label: rust yes or no
Download and check Gemma 4 E2B-it
Organize BRACOL and freeze the split: train, validation, test
Time a short training run on this Mac
Choose where to train: this Mac or a rented GPU
Step 1: zero-shot run, then fine-tune on BRACOL. Done: AUC 0.928 zero-shot, 0.978 fine-tuned
Step 2: make the synthetic leaves. Done by the other session: sets v1, v2, v3 and the bad-photo set
Step 2a: cut a leaf texture from a BRACOL photo and render it in Blender (works on 9 test leaves)
Step 2b: download real field photos for testing (Uganda set done, Kenya sample is a stress test only)
Step 2c: cut textures for the 1,225 train leaves and check the masks (1,221 usable)
Step 2d: render synthetic set v1 (1,353 photos from 1,221 train leaves) and check a sample by eye
Step 2e: render synthetic set v3, other-disease hard negatives with orange or yellow rims
Step 3: fine-tune on synthetic only, test on BRACOL. First round done: matches real on clean BRACOL, does not help on Uganda. See results/summary.md
Step 4: fine-tune on synthetic plus BRACOL. First round done: matches real on clean BRACOL, does not help on Uganda. See results/summary.md
Repeat steps 1 and 4 with 10, 25, 50 and 100% of the real photos. Done, 3 seeds
Test on real farm photos. Done: Uganda (1,792 photos) and Kenya (197)
Convert the best model for Android and try it on a phone
Hackathon: public GitHub repo with a README (setup and description). README is written and updated for round 2. Still to do: push, and confirm the repo is public
Hackathon: hosted demo link (Vercel, Replit or Lovable)
Hackathon: demo video, 60 seconds
Hackathon: tech video, 60 seconds
Hackathon: team video, 60 seconds
Hackathon: team photo
Hackathon: submit on HackOS and the Google Form before 15:00 Berlin on Sun 4 Oct. No re-submissions
AWS GPU quota: not needed. We used RunPod instead
Zero-shot baseline scored on BRACOL val and test
RunPod pod stopped by Santiago. Checked in the console: $0.00 per hour. About $5 spent
Step 1 on the pod: real-photo fine-tunes at detail 70, 140 and 280, and the 10, 25, 50 and 100% runs. Done
Zero-shot on the pod at detail 70, 140 and 280: AUC 0.941, 0.928 and 0.948 on the 261 test photos
First fine-tune on real photos (detail 140, 1,225 photos): AUC 0.978 and accuracy 92.7%, up from 0.928 and 86.6% zero-shot
Mac fine-tune stopped on purpose at step 60 of 154. All training now runs on the pod
Score the first runs on real field photos: Uganda (300) AUC 0.947 and 89.3% accuracy after fine-tuning, against 0.952 and 80.7% zero-shot. Kenya (197, stress test) is weak: AUC 0.61 and 0.42
Steps 3 and 4 runs scored on the field photos, including all 1,792 Uganda photos. Result: synthetic did not help on Uganda
Test design: real field photos (Uganda, Kenya) are the main test for the synthetic arms. BRACOL test is the second check
Steps 3 and 4 launched on the pod: stream a started at 06:34, stream b starts by itself when Step 1 ends. About 2 hours
Round 2: the other session renders the v3 synthetic set with other-disease close-ups with orange rims (target 09:15)
Round 2 trained and scored: v3 did not help on Uganda (AUC 0.908 at 100% real vs 0.946 real only). Last try, v1 plus the rimmed photos, nearly ties real only (87.5% vs 88.2%)
Set the cut-off and the not-sure margin on field photos (scripts/analyze/calibrate_field.py). About 100 local photos are enough

Checked: the brief needs its own 2 to 5 minute video (docs/challenge-04-concept-note.pdf, section 08). Entries without it do not make the shortlist. The script is video 4 in submission/video-scripts.md
Four key adapters saved to this Mac, hashes checked: real 10%, real 100%, real detail 70, and the best synthetic recipe (mix-combo)
The study is complete: zero-shot, real-only, synthetic only, synthetic plus real, v3 and combo, all scored on BRACOL, Uganda and Kenya
Video scripts for the demo, tech and team videos are in submission/video-scripts.md. The team script has FILL IN parts only you can write
scripts/model/predict.py reads a leaf photo and answers rust, no rust or not sure, in English, Spanish or Portuguese. Checked on the Mac, 25 seconds
Have a native speaker check the Spanish and Portuguese lines in scripts/model/predict.py
Record the 2 to 5 minute brief video. It is required for the shortlist. Five parts: problem sentence, AI and guardrails, demo, the gap and tech stack, your take

Repo folders reorganized. Scripts are in scripts/prepare, synth, model, analyze and gpu. BRACOL photos are in data/bracol/raw. See the What is where section in README.md. The talks are in presentation/talk and presentation/site.

README top rebuilt: a looping banner (a real leaf photo, the same leaf in 3D, its renders, and the bar of training photos), a results chart and a short findings table. The pictures are in docs/readme/ and come from scripts/analyze/make_readme_art.py
